title: Slices of Summer Cake  (여름 케이크 한 조각의 감동)

segments.t: 활기찬 카페 카운터에서 테사가 루비빛 열매가 올라간 노릇노릇한 여름 베리 아몬드 케이크를 도자기 접시에 정성껏 담아내고, 빈 쟁반을 들고 돌아온 해나와 오언의 두 눈이 반짝입니다. 먼저 세 사람의 신나는 대화를 들어 보세요.
Tell me everything right now — did table one taste the berry almond cake yet?!
He took one small bite, closed both eyes, and tapped his hand over his heart!
Then he nodded twice to Arthur and wrote two words on his napkin: Exact match!
EXACT MATCH! Did you hear that, kitchen ovens?! Honey and orange zest won the day!
Number ten from next door said it tastes like May afternoon sunshine thirty years back.
And every single neighbor clipped their numbered birch clothespin onto their lapel like a badge!
Even that soggy poster accident turned into the hit fashion trend of Linden Street!
Here go six more slices for table three — save two big corners for the musicians!
Listen — Evelyn and Caleb just sat down side by side on the walnut piano bench!
Turn down the tea kettle burner so the whole courtyard hears every single note!
Come stand by the archway with us, Tessa — the ovens earned a five-minute break!
Wiping my hands right now — play us home, Room Nine!
주방의 달콤한 승리를 담은 대화를 한 줄씩 함께 음미해 볼까요.
Tell me everything right now — did table one taste the berry almond cake yet?!
'지금 당장 하나도 빠짐없이 다 말해 줘요 — 일 번 테이블에서 베리 아몬드 케이크는 벌써 맛보셨나요?!'
He took one small bite, closed both eyes, and tapped his hand over his heart!
'작게 한 입 베어 무시고는 두 눈을 지그시 감더니 가슴 위에 손을 톡톡 얹으시더군요!'
Then he nodded twice to Arthur and wrote two words on his napkin: Exact match!
'그러고는 아서 씨를 향해 고개를 두 번 끄덕이시고 냅킨 위에 두 단어를 적으셨어요, 완벽히 똑같음!'
EXACT MATCH! Did you hear that, kitchen ovens?! Honey and orange zest won the day!
'완벽히 똑같다고요! 주방 오븐들아 방금 들었니?! 꿀이랑 오렌지 제스트가 오늘 큰일을 해냈구나!'
Number ten from next door said it tastes like May afternoon sunshine thirty years back.
'바로 옆집 십 번 손님은 삼십 년 전 오월 오후의 햇살 같은 맛이 난다고 하셨어요.'
And every single neighbor clipped their numbered birch clothespin onto their lapel like a badge!
'게다가 이웃분들 모두 번호가 적힌 자작나무 빨래집게를 배지처럼 옷깃에 꽂으셨답니다!'
Even that soggy poster accident turned into the hit fashion trend of Linden Street!
'물에 흠뻑 젖어 버렸던 좌석표 사고마저 린든 거리의 최고 인기 유행이 되었네요!'
Here go six more slices for table three — save two big corners for the musicians!
'자, 삼 번 테이블로 여섯 조각 더 나갑니다 — 연주자 두 분 몫으로 큼직한 모서리 두 조각은 남겨 두세요!'
Listen — Evelyn and Caleb just sat down side by side on the walnut piano bench!
'귀 기울여 봐요 — 에블린 선생님과 케일럽이 방금 호두나무 피아노 의자에 나란히 앉았어요!'
Turn down the tea kettle burner so the whole courtyard hears every single note!
'안뜰 전체에 음표 하나하나가 또렷이 들리도록 찻주전자 화구 불을 줄여 주세요!'
Come stand by the archway with us, Tessa — the ovens earned a five-minute break!
'테사도 우리랑 같이 아치 통로 옆에 서서 들어요 — 오븐들도 오 분쯤 쉴 자격이 충분하잖아요!'
Wiping my hands right now — play us home, Room Nine!
'지금 바로 손 닦고 갈게요 — 구 호실, 우리 마음을 포근히 감싸는 연주를 들려주세요!'
이제 자연스러운 속도로 장면 전체를 다시 들어 보세요.
Tell me everything right now — did table one taste the berry almond cake yet?!
He took one small bite, closed both eyes, and tapped his hand over his heart!
Then he nodded twice to Arthur and wrote two words on his napkin: Exact match!
EXACT MATCH! Did you hear that, kitchen ovens?! Honey and orange zest won the day!
Number ten from next door said it tastes like May afternoon sunshine thirty years back.
And every single neighbor clipped their numbered birch clothespin onto their lapel like a badge!
Even that soggy poster accident turned into the hit fashion trend of Linden Street!
Here go six more slices for table three — save two big corners for the musicians!
Listen — Evelyn and Caleb just sat down side by side on the walnut piano bench!
Turn down the tea kettle burner so the whole courtyard hears every single note!
Come stand by the archway with us, Tessa — the ovens earned a five-minute break!
Wiping my hands right now — play us home, Room Nine!
냅킨 위에 적힌 완벽히 똑같음이라는 두 단어가 테사의 주방에 눈부신 왕관을 씌워 주고, 호두나무 피아노 건반 위로 네 손이 내려앉습니다. 다음 장면에서는 구 호실 선룸 안으로 들어가 볼게요!
See you next time!
